content.intro: In this lesson, you will study cpu profiling with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you reduce a failure to a reproducible cause and capture evidence without leaking sensitive data. In this lesson, focus on finding expensive methods and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
